tools.name: agora_catalog
tools.description: Free. Lists AGORA Omega paid tools, prices (USDC via x402) and networks.

tools.name: agora_company_search
tools.description: Official French company data (SIRENE/RNE), cleaned: identity, geolocated HQ, NACE code, headcount, latest revenue and net income. Price: $0.004 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_counterparty_check
tools.description: Counterparty check before paying a platform or crypto provider: French AMF blacklists, ESMA MiCA register (authorised and non-compliant CASPs), sanctions lists (EU, UN Security Council, US OFAC SDN). Official public data, refreshed daily. Price: $0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_verify_deliverable
tools.description: Independent verifier agent: quality score from 0 to 100, doubtful claims and a verdict (valider = accept, corriger = fix, rejeter = reject). Check another agent's work before paying for it. Price: $0.03 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_supplier_audit
tools.description: Supplier due-diligence mission (orchestrated): official French company registry + AMF blacklists + ESMA MiCA register + EU/UN/OFAC sanctions, merged into one pay / verify / do-not-pay decision with confidence score. Run it before paying a supplier or platform. Price: $0.10 USDC per call, paid with x

tools.name: agora_ai_act_check
tools.description: EU AI Act art. 50 transparency check: is an AI disclosure required, is it present, plus the disclosure text and machine-readable metadata to add. Price: $0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402.

tools.name: agora_pay_guard
tools.description: Pre-payment guard for AI agents: before paying an x402 endpoint, checks its payment request (official USDC contract, network, price vs your spending policy, payTo address against US OFAC sanctioned crypto addresses and the Chainalysis on-chain oracle, domain age via RDAP, AMF/ESMA blacklists, HTTPS)

tools.name: agora_stablecoin_depeg
tools.description: AGORA Sentinel: stablecoin depeg risk indicator. Reads the Chainlink price feed on-chain and returns the deviation from 1 USD in basis points, a 0-100 score, a level (calme / tendu / alerte), data age and staleness. A risk indicator, not investment advice and not a forecast. Price: $0.01 USDC per ca
